items.title: John E. Wood Interview, 1986-06-26
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ... Scott Hill. I assume that's who you're talking about. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, and Greg Stafford plays with them.

ctx.x: But, I love the music, and I, I like the, the, really, I like the traditional, music, um, over at the Café Mediterranean, that is just a little too hokey for me, that's too, too, too tourist, uh, oriented, somehow, or all. I just don't really.
The French Market Jazz Band, you're talking about. Yeah, is that what it's called? Scott Hill. I assume that's who you're talking about.
Yeah, and Greg Stafford plays with them.
